name: Weakness, Greater Mass
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, inquisitor 4, paladin 4, psychic 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner/unchained summoner 4, witch 4

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater weakness except as noted above.
